name: Gorm Halfhand
role: Quay porter, ex-Ash Company; the Hawk's grand old man
backstory: Gorm served eight years in the Ash Companies on the South March until he lost two fingers at Fort Vell, learned the Hawk from Shaaran horse-traders there, and won the Open three times, dancing the hawk dance on the chalk after each.

relationships.name: Old Wenna Hollis
relationships.how: she made him buy a round for taunting, every time

statblock.notes: missing two fingers of his left hand; older and slower now
